proteus.theme.classic.description: The plain old Minecraft look: dirt background, square gray buttons, no animations.
proteus.theme.liquid_glass.description: Clear glass that bends and tints what is behind it, with bright edges and springy motion.
proteus.theme.aero.description: Windows 7: frosted glass frames in your accent color, glossy gray buttons and a light client area.
proteus.theme.win98.description: Windows 98: gray square surfaces with raised and sunken bevels, a blue title bar and a teal desktop.
proteus.ui.locked_accent_note: This theme sets its own colors.
proteus.ui.blur.tooltip: Blurs the game behind the menu. The strength comes from Minecraft's Menu Background Blur option.
proteus.ui.toast.duration: How long a toast stays on screen.
proteus.ui.toast.preview.tooltip: Shows a toast so you can see where it ends up.
proteus.ui.toast.sample: This is how a toast looks
proteus.ui.toast.heading: Toasts
proteus.hub.title: Proteus
proteus.tab.appearance.tooltip: Style, accent color, effects and where toasts appear. Applies to every mod that uses Proteus.
proteus.tab.vanilla.tooltip: Choose which parts of the game's own interface Proteus draws: toasts, chat, menus, effects and tooltips.
proteus.tab.mods.tooltip: Turn the Proteus look on or off for other mods you have installed.
proteus.mods.heading: Supported mods
proteus.mods.note: Mods listed here have menus Proteus can draw. Turn one off to get its own menus back.
proteus.mods.none: None of the supported mods are installed.
proteus.mods.voicechat.tooltip: Draw the Simple Voice Chat menus with Proteus.
proteus.vanilla.heading: Game interface
proteus.vanilla.note: Each switch lets Proteus draw that part of the game in the current theme. Turn one off and the vanilla one comes back.
proteus.surface.toasts.tooltip: Advancement, recipe, tutorial and system toasts.
proteus.surface.chat.tooltip: The chat window and its input field, animated by the theme.
proteus.surface.menus.tooltip: The title screen and the pause menu, including the Mod Menu button.
proteus.surface.effects.tooltip: The active effects shown in game and in the inventory.
proteus.surface.tooltips.tooltip: Button, item and message tooltips drawn in the theme.
proteus.effects.heading: Effects
proteus.effects.hud.tooltip: Draw the effect icons at the top right of the screen.
proteus.effects.hud_time.tooltip: Show the time left under each icon in game.
proteus.effects.inventory.tooltip: Draw the effect list next to the inventory.
proteus.effects.compact.tooltip: Show only the icons in the inventory. The name and time appear when you hover one.
proteus.chat.heading: Chat
proteus.chat.note: Messages, the input field and the scrollbar are drawn with the theme. On 26.1 and newer each message is a floating bubble. Links, hover text, suggestions and signed messages work as before.
proteus.chat.opacity.tooltip: Theme uses the opacity of the theme. Game scales it with the game's Text Background Opacity, where 50% is the theme's own.
proteus.chat.animate.tooltip: New messages and the input field move in the way the theme says. Themes without chat animations stay still.
proteus.chat.compact.tooltip: Less padding and a smaller gap between message bubbles. Versions without bubbles keep the flat lines.
proteus.toasts.heading: Game toasts
proteus.toasts.note: Proteus can draw the game's own toasts in its style and in the corner you picked. Set a kind to Vanilla to keep the normal toast.
proteus.toasts.advancements.tooltip: Advancement made, goal reached and challenge complete.
proteus.toasts.tutorial.tooltip: Hints like "Move with WASD" or "Punch a tree".
proteus.toasts.system.tooltip: Notices from the game itself, such as world backups, unsecure servers and narrator changes.
proteus.menus.heading: Menus
proteus.menus.note: Buttons and backdrops follow the theme. Every button keeps doing what it did, including the ones other mods add.
proteus.menus.title: Title screen
proteus.menus.title.tooltip: Draw the main menu with the theme. Mod Menu's button is included.
proteus.menus.pause.tooltip: Draw the game menu with the theme. Mod Menu's button is included.
proteus.menus.screens.tooltip: Options, worlds, servers and every other screen that opens from the menus. Buttons, sliders, fields and lists follow the theme.
